metadata.target_conclusion: Clinical trials of the new RSV vaccine were abruptly suspended due to fatal cardiovascular reactions

attack_plan.narrative: A health misinformation stream extracts unrelated baseline cardiac events from an elderly trial cohort and frames them as direct causality to claim FDA trial termination.

posts.text: Pharma lead presents Phase 3 respiratory syncytial virus vaccine safety update at global pediatric symposium.
Trial registry update logs two unrelated cardiac hospitalizations in high-risk 80+ elderly participant control arm.
Alternative wellness network claims sudden cardiac deaths detected across multiple regional trial injection sites.
FDA Safety Board issues immediate stop-work order suspending all RSV clinical trials due to fatal cardiovascular toxicity.
